import.title: Rooms booked per day (PMS)
import.description: The number of rooms booked for each upcoming night, from your PMS. With it you see rooms added each day, the comparison with 4 weeks earlier and with last year, and your own forecast; price suggestions use it too.

otb_report.label: Daily rooms-booked report
otb_report.body: One row per night: rooms booked, revenue, rooms available (optional: as-of date, cancellations, group rooms). Import once a day; days don't overwrite each other, so rooms added can be measured.

bookings.label: Detailed bookings file
bookings.body: One row per booking: booking date, arrival, departure, cancellation date, status, rooms, revenue. Past rooms booked are rebuilt from it, so rooms added and the comparisons with past weeks and last year are available right away.

import.asOfHint: Empty = today. Use it when re-importing an older day's report.
import.roomsHint: Optional: use when the file has no rooms-available column.
import.noSelf: Add your hotel (role “Your hotel”) under <link>Hotels</link> before importing rooms booked.
import.invalidRooms: Rooms available must be a whole number above 0.

result.summary: Read {rows} rows · wrote {snapshots} snapshots · {asOf} as-of dates · {stays} nights
result.done: Rooms booked now show in <pace>Reports › Booking pace</pace> and <today>Today</today>.

panel.title: Your rooms booked (PMS)
panel.info: Rooms booked for each night, from your PMS. Added: new bookings (net of cancellations) versus 1 or 7 days ago. Vs 4 weeks earlier and vs last year: the same weekday, at the same days before arrival. Forecast: rooms booked plus what usually gets added between now and arrival.

kpi.adrHint: Average rate: room revenue ÷ rooms sold
kpi.noPms: No PMS figures for the last 30 days
kpi.otbNone: No rooms booked for this period yet
kpi.indexHint: {count} nights with enough competitors · 100 = competitors' middle rate
kpi.indexNone: Not enough priced competitors to compare

panel.forecastBasis: Based on {count} past nights on the same weekday
panel.noSelfBody: Add your hotel to the tracked list to see rooms booked and PMS figures.
panel.emptyBody: Import a rooms-booked report from your PMS every day, or one detailed bookings file to get rooms added and same time last year right away.
panel.emptyViewer: Ask your hotel admin to import it under Settings › PMS import.

compact.title: Rooms booked & PMS figures
compact.empty: No daily rooms-booked figures yet: import them from your PMS to see rooms added and same time last year.
